subject: Shiny R leaflet Map: To show the respective marker onselect

messages.author: a45a2eb15b7dbe86
messages.subject: Shiny R leaflet Map: To show the respective marker onselect
parts:
Hi all,

I am new to shiny r and would like to ask how can i show the marker on map on selecting an option from the dropdown list?

Currently i am doing the following, however it just keep adding markers on the map whenever i select another dropdown option. I only want to show a marker at a time.

observeEvent(input$dropdownInput, {
       leafletProxy('map') %>%
         addMarkers(lng = subset(DF, outcome == input$dropdownInput)$lon, lat = subset(DF, outcome == input$dropdownInput)$lat, popup = subset(DF, outcome == input$dropdownInput)$outcome)
   })


thanks for the help in advance!

Regards,
Hui Min
